notes.title: Patch 3
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Astryl here for another update!

Improvements:

 Added binoculars which allow you to freely look at a section of a level
 Added an interaction icon for characters and binoculars
 Added currently collected presents to the in game menu
 Added the Escape key as a secondary start input
 Made the start key close menus


Bug fixes:

 Fixed some achievements not unlocking
 Fixed level save points not being erased when starting a new game

notes.title: Patch 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Astryl here!

Let me start of by saying that the save directory has changed from %appdata%/../LocalLow/ShortCake_Cafe/GhoulScrappers to %appdata%/../LocalLow/ShortCake_Cafe/GhoulScrapers. Your saves should be moved automatically but if they don't you should look there or ask us for assistance.

Now onto the exciting stuff!

 Added level progress saving so you can now exit a level and come back to where you left off!
 Added the jukebox so you can jam out to the game's music!
 Settings are now accessible from anywhere
 The total number of deaths is now shown on the save file


Small changes and bug fixes:

 Fixed typo in the game's title on the window name
 Fixed inputs not showing when rebinding one
 Added menu asking for confirmation when overwriting a save file
 "Continue" option only shows when a save file exists

notes.title: Ghoulscrapers - Patch 1
notes.content:
Hey all, ShortCake here!
Here are the patch logs for the newest update:


 Added cloud saving
 The "I wanna be the Ghoul" achievement now shows the total death count
 Added new sprites to the end orb
 Added an area in the HQ to allow the player to replay tutorials
 Controls are now locked during the level transition
 Added a joystick threshold for fast falling
 Fixed a bug where moving platforms stopped a pixel short
 Fixed some spikes in the b-side of "Cookie Crust Factory"
 Fixed a bug where the timer wouldn't stop while pausing during a death
 Fixed an oversight in the "Ghoulscraper" where red tiles were on the blue tilemap
 Fixed an oversight where the wrong sprite was shown the save file
 Fixed a bug where players could enter levels while paused in the world map

notes.title: Welcome to Ghoulscrapers!
notes.content:
Hey all, ShortCake here.
We hope you've all been enjoying your time with Ghoulscrapers!

MEET THE DEV TEAM
Since most of you might not know us, I think this is a good time to introduce ourselves!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45155568/66d4e020c32daa8521a18f4b746f0b8d64ee4667.png

Mostly Astryl and I will be taking care of patching the game post-release.

OUR PLANS GOING FOWARD
At the time of writing this, we have no plans to introduce content updates. 
However, we will be making quality of life improvements and bug fixes when necessary!

TO CONTENT CREATORS, ARTISTS, ETC...
If you want to make fanart or just wanna post stuff related to Ghoulscrapers, use #ghoulscrapers on social medias!
If you're a streamer or youtuber, feel free to record your playthrough, we love receiving your feedback!



Anyways, that's all for now. Have fun!
